liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this Jack Straw among the best ever played of the song [7]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls this The Other One one of the finest versions ever [7]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Sugar Magnolia ridiculously hot [10]
- **Mississippi Half Step** (1 review): Garcia's solo passes through melodic verse runs, repeated arpeggios, and builds note by note to a climax [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-11-05.aud.zimmerman.minches.81180.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 178 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1977-11-05.152194.aud.warburton.smith.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 174 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd77-11-05.sbd.clugston.6934.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 165 min; rated 4.44/5 by 25 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says Jerry's guitar solos are lyrical, with clear structure, beginning, middle and end; Reviewer says the recording's sound quality hardly matters given the playing; Reviewer finds the soundboard has far too much bass [7][8][15][18]
- **gd1977-11-05.152193.aud.warburton.smith.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 21 songs; 174 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Band repeatedly urged the crowd to take a step back during the night [9]
- Reviewer says it rivals the band's 1976 Rochester War Memorial show and the Cornell spring 1977 show [9]
- Reviewer says Fall 1977 shows were played far rougher and rockier than the band's mellower approach in other years [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-11-05.aud.zimmerman.minches.81180.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Zimmerman; transferred by David Minches; source: Master Audience Cassette; Sony Stereo Mic> Sony TC-158 (Maxell UD XLII-90s) [1]. Also: Jerry Moore's master supplied a patch for It Must Have Been The Roses [1]
- **gd1977-11-05.152194.aud.warburton.smith.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jimmy Warburton; transferred by Matt Smith and Scott Clugston; source: Jimmy Warburton's Master Audience Cassettes; most likely AKG d1000e mics > unknown deck (dolby on); master cassettes (Nakamichi 550, dolby off) > 1st… [2]. Also: Unknown audience source supplies patches in Mama Tried, Samson & Delilah and the Phil, Billy and Mickey jam; Joe B. Jones verified pitch [2]
- **gd77-11-05.sbd.clugston.6934.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: This show was released as Dick's Picks volume 34; Soundboard cassette master went to reel-to-reel then DAT, with audience patches; Scott Clugston patched and mastered it [4][16]
- **gd1977-11-05.152193.aud.warburton.smith.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jimmy Warburton; transferred by Matt Smith, Scott Clugston; source: Jimmy Warburton's Master Audience Cassettes; most likely AKG d1000e mics > unknown deck (dolby on); master cassettes (Nakamichi 550, dolby off) > 1st… [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Community War Memorial - November 5, 1977](https://www.dead.net/show/november-5-1977) [20]
